patterns.note: Sections alternate between a deep teal/forest green background and a warm light beige background, creating clear visual separation and rhythm down the page.
A single sans-serif typeface is used across the site, with a clear hierarchy established through large, bold headings, regular body text, and small, uppercase labels for categories or metadata.
The primary brand palette consists of a deep teal/forest green, a warm light beige, and a vibrant coral/pink accent, used for backgrounds, text, and graphic elements.

The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, providing persistent access to site navigation. No other scroll-triggered content reveals or animations are observed.
Testimonials are presented as direct quotes from individuals, accompanied by their name, title, and company, reinforcing credibility and trust.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header navigation that remains fixed at the top of the viewport on scroll. Content sections should alternate background colors (deep teal and light beige) to visually segment the page. Use a consistent grid system for displaying service offerings, case studies, client logos, and blog posts, typically in 3 or 4 columns. Content reveals are static; elements simply scroll into view without additional animation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual hierarchy, complemented by readable body text and small, uppercase labels for categorization.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle corner radii (small curve) are applied to buttons, cards, and image containers, softening the overall aesthetic without being overtly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing throughout, with generous vertical padding between sections creating an airy feel, while content within sections maintains a comfortable density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, rich teal/forest green paired with a warm, muted beige and a vibrant coral/pink accent creates a sophisticated and memorable brand identity. This unique color combination, along with abstract geometric graphics, elevates the design beyond a typical corporate template.
